content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment is 08 October 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the JRF position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA. This is a competitive stipend for research fellows.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the JRF position, candidates must have completed M.Sc. or M.Tech in Geophysics or Physics. A mandatory GATE/NET qualification is also required.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment must be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this IIT Roorkee JRF recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF position at IIT Roorkee will primarily be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview date for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview for the JRF recruitment at IIT Roorkee is scheduled to be held on 16 October 2026. Candidates are advised to be prepared for the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment drive by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity. The selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis for the JRF position at IIT Roorkee.
